{{Top|leg}}
'''Illumination banks''' were a group of high-powered lamps that were strong enough to light large public areas. They were used in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and arenas, as well as in the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]] within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
